job.rawJd:
Product Manager II (Remote)

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

At Globe Life, we are committed to empowering our employees with the support and opportunities they need to succeed at every stage of their career. We take pride in fostering a caring and innovative culture that enables us to collectively grow and overcome challenges in a connected, collaborative, and mutually respectful environment that calls us to help Make Tomorrow Better.

Role Overview

Could you be our next Product Manager II? Globe Life is looking for a Product Manager II to join the team!

This role is responsible for partnering with business sponsors to manage product intake, prioritization, and roadmap development while aligning product strategy with the broader portfolio. The Product Manager II takes a consultative, value-driven approach to maintain strong relationships with both business stakeholders and engineering and delivery leaders, ensuring roadmaps are executed as promised and meaningful value outcomes are achieved. This role serves as the accountable delivery leader for assigned products and platforms, overseeing all intake, coordinating prioritization, and providing estimates.

This is a remote/work-from-home position.

What You Will Do

- Collaborate with business sponsors on product decisions, prioritization, and backlog refinement to maintain a consistently up-to-date, prioritized backlog of clearly defined features and stories.
- Maintain product roadmaps based on delivery team capacity, sprint plans, and KPIs, and socialize progress with business sponsors.
- Coordinate with Agile development teams on sprint definition, backlog prioritization, and release of MVPs.
- Support scrum masters and development leads in identifying dependencies, constrained resources, and navigating development roadblocks.
- Engage cross-functional stakeholders, technical architects, and engineering teams to develop the best solution options.
- Enable iterative implementations to solicit stakeholder feedback early and often.
- Ensure governance, standards, and best practices are adhered to across all team members.
- Drive continuous improvement for delivery processes and prioritized initiatives.
- Understand data, privacy, architecture, and information security standards to effectively bridge the gap between business and IT teams.
- Summarize quarterly and annual value delivery to support business sponsors in crafting a compelling investment story for products.

What You Can Bring

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or equivalent field.
- At least 1 year of product management or related experience; insurance industry knowledge is a plus.
- Strong relationship building and collaboration skills across diverse and matrixed stakeholders.
- Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and deadlines simultaneously.
- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, including experience interpreting data with limited context.
- Ability to communicate complex technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Experience translating user needs into technical user stories and making timely prioritization decisions.
- Familiarity with Agile software delivery practices and various SDLC methodologies.
- Demonstrated success in defining and building products with a customer-centric approach.

Applicable To All Employees of Globe Life Family of Companies:

Reliable and predictable attendance of your assigned shift.
Ability to work full time and/or part time based on the position specifications.

How Globe Life Will Support You

Competitive compensation designed to reflect your expertise and contribution. Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans. Robust life insurance benefits and retirement plans, including company-matched 401k and pension plan. Paid holidays and time off. Parental leave. Subsidized all-in-one subscriptions for fitness, mindfulness, nutrition, and sleep goals. Company-paid counseling. Continued education reimbursement eligibility and company-paid FLMI and ICA courses. Discounted Texas Rangers tickets.
